metadata.currency: Text contains those laws in effect on April 8, 2026

statute.heading: §1036. Stock for stock of same corporation

children.label: (a)
children.heading: General rule
children.text: No gain or loss shall be recognized if common stock in a corporation is exchanged solely for common stock in the same corporation, or if preferred stock in a corporation is exchanged solely for preferred stock in the same corporation.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: Nonqualified preferred stock not treated as stock
children.text: For purposes of this section, nonqualified preferred stock (as defined in section 351(g)(2)) shall be treated as property other than stock.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Cross references
children.text: (1) For rules relating to recognition of gain or loss where an exchange is not solely in kind, see subsections (b) and (c) of section 1031. (2) For rules relating to the basis of property acquired in an exchange described in subsection (a), see subsection (d) of section 1031.

entries: Subsecs. (b), (c). Pub. L. 105–34 added subsec. (b) and redesignated former subsec. (b) as (c).

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1997 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 105–34 applicable, with certain exceptions, to transactions after June 8, 1997, see section 1014(f) of Pub. L. 105–34, set out as a note under section 351 of this title.
